notes.title: Byte Breach Status #1 - First Transmission
notes.content:
Hey Data Rebels!

Welcome to the first Byte Breach Status. We're here to share some of the cool stuff we've been working on and give you a sneak peek into the wild world of Byte Breach. Byte Breach is developed by just two passionate individuals. Ready to dive in?

[b]What is Byte Breach?[/b]
Welcome to Byte Breach, a co-op survival-horror game set in a dystopian future ruled by AI overlords. As a brave data rebel, your mission is to infiltrate high-security AI fortresses, steal valuable data, and disrupt the digital tyranny. Byte Breach combines strategic planning, teamwork, and clever tactics with a spooky twist, blending intense heists with nerve-wracking horror. Think of it as navigating a haunted maze where your greatest enemy is an all-seeing, all-knowing AI system.

[b]Recent Developments[/b]
We’re still in the early stages, but we’ve got some awesome (and a little rough around the edges) features to show you. Check out these sneak peeks:

[b]Spider Crawling[/b]
Meet our spider-like enemy, still learning to navigate like a pro. Our procedural animation and navigation system is coming together, and it’s looking pretty creepy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903899/a6f45b403ad02ec03f0f7f5ffff6c63b6bf2f584.gif[/img]

[b]Wheel Locomotion[/b]
Say hello to the "Death Wheel." This early footage shows its unique movement mechanics. It’s not rolling smoothly yet, but it’s getting there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903899/b3e813092dc32587dde863c047e883ac7dcfe545.gif[/img]


[b]Specter Patrol[/b]
Watch our Specter drones patrol their environments like they own the place. This early look shows off their navigation skills in complex spaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903899/6955596d69e1c0d306df4343d5c183c6f5502268.gif[/img]

[b]Data Collection[/b]
Data collection is the name of the game. Here’s a raw look at how you’ll extract and secure information. It’s still very-very rough, but you get the idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903899/11aed182d6b324772317dabe292d0a3ce2aaa5c0.gif[/img]

[b]Capsules Traveling[/b]
Traveling between the digital and real worlds is a key mechanic. Check out this early footage showing how you’ll zip between realities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903899/57e1de0f788992029e63e0dc43364623bd5abbcd.gif[/img]

[b]Procedural Levels[/b]
Every mission is a new adventure thanks to our procedural level generation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903899/d69a99890a560ae617a7519c11a26db6283a48d4.gif[/img]




[b]Join Our Community[/b]
We love hearing from you! Join our community to stay updated, share your thoughts, and help us make Byte Breach even better.

[b]Join our Discord:[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/dDxkBArW83][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903899/9b04c7329b70f88b76a7987952011b8feecd518c.gif[/img][/url]


[b]Wishlist Byte Breach:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633940/Byte_Breach/

Stay tuned for more updates, insights, and behind-the-scenes looks. We plan to release a new status report each month (or even more frequently) to keep you in the loop.

Mark your calendars, as we are planning to [b]release Byte Breach in November-December 2024[/b]. Your support and feedback are crucial as we work towards this goal.
